metadata.prompt: Scroll through the Wranngle Systems homepage from top to bottom in deliberate moves, pausing briefly so each major section is visible. Hover over the navigation if present. Do not click any external links or trigger the voice agent. Once you reach the bottom, call the done tool.

steps.text: Starting to explore the Wranngle Systems homepage. Currently at the top of the page.
steps.label: Narration
Hover over the Offerings button to show navigation menu

steps.text: Navigation menu shows Offerings, About, and other options. Now scrolling down to view the main content sections.
steps.label: Narration
Scroll down to view the hero section and main content

steps.text: Scrolled to 21% of the page. Can see the main call-to-action buttons. Continuing to scroll down.
steps.label: Narration
Continue scrolling to view more sections

steps.text: Now at 30% of the page. Viewing more of the features section. Continuing to scroll down.
steps.label: Narration
Continue scrolling through the features section

steps.text: Reached 40% of the page. More offerings appear including AI Agents, Websites, and other options. Continuing to scroll.
steps.label: Narration
Continue scrolling to view the middle section

steps.text: Almost at the halfway point (49% of page). Seeing product offerings including Core Agent and Elite Agent options with spec sheets. Continuing to scroll.
steps.label: Narration
Continue scrolling to view more product details

steps.text: Past the halfway point at 59% of the page. Seeing voice demo options and pricing links. Continuing to scroll down.
steps.label: Narration
Continue scrolling through the lower sections

steps.text: Now at 68% of the page. Seeing FAQ section with questions about deployment speed, equipment requirements, and business learning. Continuing to scroll.
steps.label: Narration
Continue scrolling toward the bottom sections

steps.text: Now at 77% of the page. Viewing more FAQ questions covering human handoff, lead qualification, customization, language support, and plan limits. Getting close to the end. Continuing to scroll.
steps.label: Narration
Continue scrolling to reach the bottom section

steps.text: At 87% of the page. More FAQ questions about cancellation, data safety, multiple locations, and gtm_ops. Can see footer starting to appear. Almost at the end. Continue scrolling.
steps.label: Narration
Final scroll to reach the very bottom of the page

steps.text: Reached the bottom of the page at 96%. The footer section shows links to all major navigation items, products, policies, and social media. Complete homepage tour finished.
steps.label: Narration
